outputs.explanation: This is a stacked bar chart showing, for each Pol II ChIP-seq bin, the median frequency of each promoter state across the underlying promoters in that bin. Since medians are displayed as bars, the underlying individual promoter-level data points are not shown anywhere in the panel, and no overlay of individual values is present.

The main plot is a single-molecule stack where each row is an individual DNA molecule (2952 molecules), so the individual data points underlying the state-frequency sidebar are already displayed directly in the panel.
Same representation as panel A (stacked bar chart of median state frequencies per Pol II ChIP-seq bin for mouse promoters), with no individual promoter data points shown.
Same representation as panel B (single-molecule stack of 2871 individual molecules), so individual data points are already displayed in the panel.

This is a box plot, which already conveys the distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, outliers) of the underlying PIC occupancy data; box plots are exempt from requiring an additional overlay of individual points.
This is a box plot, which already conveys the distribution of the underlying Pol II occupancy data; box plots are exempt from requiring an additional overlay of individual points.
